body:
Follow-up to `robofab-jointspeed` (its "trapezoidal baseline" next step). Against a tuned trapezoidal-velocity move, the time-optimal carry's advantage under tight joint-speed limits falls from ~46% (over min-jerk) to 0.4–2.9% at 2 and 1 rad/s; without a speed limit it still wins by 8.7–22.5%. Stylised, assumed parameters; stdlib only; 37 tests; `python site/build.py` prints ok.

Landing note: no open PRs at start; `simdesign-gaugepockets` duplicated `simdesign-pocketmesh` on main, so it was left alone.
